verdicts.reason: A keeps the confetti backdrop and the book cover beside the card, so it still reads as the same design. But the logo is shrunk to an illegible speck and crammed into a corner beside the eyebrow, the card bleeds off the top and right edges, and the legal copy is set nearly as large as the body text next to the CTA. B drops the confetti background entirely and turns the canvas into a flat cream panel, losing the brand's signature texture. Its body copy is about as big as the headline and competes with it, and the book cover is jammed into the top-left corner while the logo floats on its own, which makes the layout feel scattered.
